_comment: Completed Phase-4 E09 evidence. Every external byte is centrally pinned; natural, causal, lifecycle and native-card branches remain explicitly separated.

card_serialization.save_copy: resident scene/progress block -> card file buffer
card_serialization.load_copy: card file buffer -> resident scene/progress block
card_serialization.classification: native card data owns resident scene/pickup progress, not Region-A gate state or the live grain HUD mirror

law.denial_cooldown_rule: next byte from pointer 0x800822F4 plus 60, then decrement once per gate update

tunnels_function.provenance: hash-pinned pristine save-state overlay; staged overlay differs

native_load.classification: native frontend load replaced initialized resident state with an exact card-resident 336-byte progress block

grain_hud_mirror.result: outside the native serialized source range

native_save.classification: native frontend save copied the exact controlled resident progress block into a card file; no card bytes are retained

card_persistence.failed_hypothesis: 0x800A65A1 is a live HUD/objective mirror, not a direct card field; the native copy range instead owns persistent scene/pickup records
card_persistence.gate_persistence_law: Tunnels and City gate words are Region-A transient state and are not serialized. Scene setup initializes its gate shape; current progress regenerates grain, and threshold plus proximity/update can open the gate again.

tunnels.perturbation: health:=0 and current/previous position:=verified hostile actor center; all subsequent death, life decrement and safe-anchor recovery are native
tunnels.classification: same-scene native death preserves the already-open gate, grain count and safe anchor while decrementing one life

city.perturbation: health:=0 and current/previous position:=verified hostile actor center; all subsequent death, life decrement and safe-anchor recovery are native
city.classification: same-scene native death preserves the already-open gate, grain count and safe anchor while decrementing one life

excluded_instrumentation.method: accessLog watch on grain during LEVEL07 gate01 replay
excluded_instrumentation.reason: interpreter watch changed the final PC and RAM hash; it is not cycle/state-neutral and is excluded from behavioral predicates
excluded_instrumentation.retained_lead: 76 reads at 0x800B3E04; statically corroborated by the pinned LEVEL04 overlay

tunnels_static_provenance.boundary: The checked-out staged Tunnels overlay differs from the centrally pinned save-owned image.
tunnels_static_provenance.rule: Retain the live bounded hash/words; do not claim a staged byte match until a hash-verified retail extraction produces that exact image.
